skills.label: Use Claude Code in the cloud
skills.desc: Run Claude Code sessions in the cloud from your browser, phone, Desktop app, or terminal, move them with `--cloud` and `--teleport`, and auto-fix pull requests. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web

skills.label: Automate work with scheduled tasks
skills.desc: Put Claude Code on autopilot. Create scheduled tasks, formerly routines, that run in the cloud on a schedule, on API calls, or on GitHub events. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/routines

skills.label: Get started with Claude Code in the cloud
skills.desc: Run Claude Code in the cloud from your browser or phone. Connect a GitHub repository, submit a task, and review the PR without local setup. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/web-quickstart

skills.label: Desktop application
skills.desc: Get more out of Claude Code Desktop: parallel sessions with Git isolation, drag-and-drop pane layout, integrated terminal and file editor, side chats, computer use, Dispatch sessions from your phone, visual diff review, app previews, PR monitoring, connectors, and enterprise configuration. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop

skills.label: Test iOS apps in the simulator
skills.desc: Claude Code Desktop opens your app in the iOS Simulator pane when Claude builds, runs, or checks it. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-ios-simulator

skills.label: Claude Desktop on Linux (beta)
skills.desc: Install and update the Claude desktop app on Ubuntu and Debian Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-linux

skills.label: Get started with the desktop app
skills.desc: Install the Claude desktop app, open the Code tab, and start your first Claude Code session on a project folder on your computer. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-quickstart

skills.label: Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Code Desktop
skills.desc: Set up scheduled tasks in Claude Code Desktop to run Claude automatically on a recurring basis for daily code reviews, dependency audits, or morning briefings. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-scheduled-tasks

skills.label: Claude Code Desktop in WSL
skills.desc: Run Code sessions inside a WSL 2 distribution on Windows Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-wsl

skills.label: Code Review
skills.desc: Catch bugs in GitHub pull requests with Code Review: Claude reviews each change, verifies its findings, and comments inline. For Team and Enterprise plans Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review

skills.label: Code Review costs and usage
skills.desc: Estimate and cap what your organization spends on Claude Code Review: how reviews are billed through usage credits, what drives cost, and where to track usage. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review-costs

skills.label: Customize Code Review
skills.desc: Tune what Code Review flags on your pull requests with REVIEW.md and CLAUDE.md: recalibrate severity, skip paths, add checks, and see which copy applies. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review-customize

skills.label: Read and request reviews on a pull request
skills.desc: Read Code Review findings on your GitHub pull request, respond to or dismiss them, and request a review with `@claude review`. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review-pull-requests

skills.label: Set up Code Review
skills.desc: Turn on Code Review for your Claude organization: connect GitHub, install the Claude GitHub App, choose repositories, and set when reviews run Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review-setup

skills.label: Troubleshoot Code Review
skills.desc: Fix a Code Review that didn't start, failed, or was skipped for budget, find missing findings, and resolve setup and `REVIEW.md` problems. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review-troubleshooting

skills.label: Review locally with /code-review
skills.desc: Run `/code-review` in a Claude Code session to find bugs in your branch's changes, point the review at a pull request or path, and have Claude apply the fixes. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-review-local

skills.label: Claude Code with GitHub Enterprise Server
skills.desc: Connect Claude Code to your self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server instance for cloud sessions, code review, and plugin marketplaces. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-enterprise-server

skills.label: Find bugs with ultrareview
skills.desc: Run a deep, multi-agent code review in the cloud with /code-review ultra to find and verify bugs before you merge. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview

skills.label: Explore the .claude directory
skills.desc: Where Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, settings.json, hooks, skills, commands, subagents, workflows, rules, and auto memory. Explore the .claude directory in your project and ~/.claude in your home directory. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-directory

skills.label: Explore the context window
skills.desc: An interactive simulation of how Claude Code's context window fills during a session. See what loads automatically, what each file read costs, and when rules and hooks fire. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/context-window

skills.label: Extend Claude Code
skills.desc: Understand when to use CLAUDE.md, Skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, and plugins. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/features-overview

skills.label: How Claude Code works
skills.desc: Understand the agentic loop, built-in tools, and how Claude Code interacts with your project. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works

skills.label: How Claude Code uses prompt caching
skills.desc: Claude Code manages prompt caching automatically. See why a model switch triggers a slow uncached turn, what `/compact` costs, why CLAUDE.md edits don't apply mid-session, and how to check your cache hit rate. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching

skills.label: Claude Code changelog
skills.desc: Release notes for Claude Code, including new features, improvements, and bug fixes by version. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog

skills.label: Overview
skills.desc: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools. Available in your terminal, IDE, desktop app, and browser. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview

skills.label: Quickstart
skills.desc: Install Claude Code in your terminal, sign in, and use the CLI to explore your codebase and make your first code change. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/quickstart

skills.label: Use Claude Code with Chrome
skills.desc: Connect Claude Code to your Chrome browser to test web apps, debug with console logs, automate form filling, and extract data from web pages. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome

skills.label: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
skills.desc: Hand Claude a stream of related tasks in one conversation and let it run them as parallel cloud sessions that share repositories, instructions, and memory. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects

skills.label: Claude Tag
skills.desc: Bring Claude into your team's Slack channels with Claude Tag and find its setup and usage documentation on claude.com. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-tag

skills.label: Let Claude use your computer from the CLI
skills.desc: Enable computer use in the Claude Code CLI so Claude can open apps, click, type, and see your screen on macOS. Test native apps, debug visual issues, and automate GUI-only tools without leaving your terminal. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/computer-use

skills.label: JetBrains IDEs
skills.desc: Use Claude Code with JetBrains IDEs including IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, and more Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/jetbrains

skills.label: Claude Code on mobile
skills.desc: Start, monitor, and steer Claude Code tasks from your phone with the Claude app for iOS and Android. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mobile

skills.label: Platforms and integrations
skills.desc: Choose where to run Claude Code and what to connect it to. Compare the CLI, Desktop, VS Code, JetBrains, web, mobile, and integrations like Chrome, Slack, and CI/CD. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/platforms

skills.label: Continue local sessions from any device with Remote Control
skills.desc: Continue a local Claude Code session from your phone, tablet, or any browser using Remote Control. Works with claude.ai/code and the Claude mobile app. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control

skills.label: Claude Code in Slack
skills.desc: Delegate coding tasks from Slack. This earlier version answers mentions only from Pro, Max, and Ultra accounts in workspaces not connected to Claude Tag. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/slack

skills.label: Use Claude Code in VS Code
skills.desc: Install and configure the Claude Code extension for VS Code. Get AI coding assistance with inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, and keyboard shortcuts. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/vs-code

skills.label: Claude Code GitHub Actions
skills.desc: Run Claude Code in GitHub Actions workflows to respond to @claude mentions, automate tasks, and turn issues into pull requests Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions

skills.label: Use Claude Code GitHub Actions with cloud providers
skills.desc: Run Claude Code GitHub Actions through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, or Microsoft Foundry instead of the Claude API Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions-cloud-providers

skills.label: Claude Code GitLab CI/CD
skills.desc: Learn about integrating Claude Code into your development workflow with GitLab CI/CD Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/gitlab-ci-cd

skills.label: Scan your codebase for vulnerabilities
skills.desc: Install the Claude Security plugin to scan your codebase for vulnerabilities in a Claude Code session and turn findings into patches you review and apply. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-security

skills.label: Catch security issues as Claude writes code
skills.desc: Install the security-guidance plugin to have Claude review its own code changes for vulnerabilities and fix them in the same session. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/security-guidance

skills.label: Best practices for Claude Code
skills.desc: Get more out of Claude Code: tell Claude what it can't see, give it a check to run, and enforce the rules that can't have exceptions. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/best-practices

skills.label: Common workflows
skills.desc: Step-by-step guides for exploring codebases, fixing bugs, refactoring, testing, and other everyday tasks with Claude Code. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/common-workflows

skills.label: How Claude remembers your project
skills.desc: Give Claude persistent instructions with CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md files, and let Claude accumulate learnings automatically with auto memory. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory

skills.label: Prompt library
skills.desc: Copy-paste prompts for Claude Code, tagged by task and role. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-library

skills.label: Manage sessions
skills.desc: Name, resume, branch, and switch between Claude Code conversations. Covers `--continue`, `--resume`, `--from-pr`, the `/resume` picker, session naming, exporting transcripts, and where transcripts are stored. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sessions
